q: What would it take to break even?
answer:
To break even in September, you would need to either reduce ad spend by ₹2,86,296 (24% of the current level) or increase contribution margin by ₹2,86,296 (a 31.6% increase). 

This means:
- Cutting ad spend to ₹9,07,026 (from ₹11,93,322) would align it with the contribution margin and eliminate the loss.
- Alternatively, increasing contribution margin to ₹11,93,322 (from ₹9,07,026) would cover the current ad spend and other costs.

Period: 2026-09-01..2026-09-30 · Currency: INR · Data as of 2026-10-29
